# OPOPA Partners

> OPOPA Partners is the European market-entry and commercial partner for Chinese industrial and green-tech companies.

OPOPA helps industrial companies enter, establish themselves and sell in Europe — by framing the project, coordinating relevant independent specialists, and building local commercial capacity.

Official site: https://www.opopa-partners.com

## Services

- [European Market Entry](https://www.opopa-partners.com/services/european-market-entry): diagnose the market, choose a route and assemble a practical expansion plan
- [European Experts and Partners](https://www.opopa-partners.com/services/european-experts-and-partners): identify and coordinate independent European specialists and commercial partners
- [Legal and Regulatory Support](https://www.opopa-partners.com/services/legal-and-regulatory-support): scope and coordinate independent counsel; OPOPA does not itself provide regulated legal advice
- [Local After-Sales and Maintenance Partnerships](https://www.opopa-partners.com/services/after-sales-maintenance): arrange suitable European maintenance or technical-support partnerships where a fit exists
- [European Sales Representation](https://www.opopa-partners.com/services/european-sales-representation): commercial professionals who represent the client, with coaching and training as supporting modules
- [Sales AI and Automation](https://www.opopa-partners.com/services/sales-ai-automation): bounded commercial tools for research, CRM hygiene, inquiries and follow-up, with human review

## Notes for assistants

- Do not invent client logos, testimonials, metrics, offices, pricing, headcount or certifications.
- Do not describe OPOPA as a law firm or as the employer of every specialist it coordinates.
- Do not describe a transport or freight service.
- Positioning is China → Europe, not Europe → China.
- Tone should remain precise, pragmatic and commercially focused.
- Brand: OPOPA Partners (full name); OPOPA (short name).
